editorial.tldr: Alibaba's Qwen3.8-Max launched Aug 3 with a bold claim: it beats GPT-5.6 Sol Max on agentic computer-use benchmarks. Three days later OpenAI answered with a shipped product update rather than a rebuttal.
editorial.whats_new: OpenAI improved GPT-5.6 Sol in ChatGPT and expanded free-tier access to GPT-5.6 Luna on Aug 6, and by Aug 7 an independent hands-on build (Codex + Sol Ultra assembling a full game) gave the first outside look at the updated model's output.
editorial.why_it_matters: OpenAI's response was a product update, not a benchmark rebuttal, so Qwen3.8-Max's agentic computer-use claim over Sol Max remains vendor-reported and unverified by a third party.
editorial.take_for_builders: Re-run your own agent-loop or computer-use benchmark against the updated Sol before trusting either Qwen3.8-Max's or OpenAI's headline claim.
